transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I don't know... my mom made me come. She says I don't do anything anymore. I just... I sit in my room a lot. I don't really feel like changing my clothes, or... doing my knitting or journaling like I used to. I don't even go for walks. When she asks me about it, I just... I don't really have the energy to talk.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like your knitting, journaling, or going for walks?

Yeah... like I just said. I guess I just can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit there in the same clothes and... I don't do them. And I barely have the energy to answer her when she asks what's wrong.
Do you feel like you’re not good enough, or find yourself blaming yourself for things that happen?
No... I don't think so. I just... I don't really think about that kind of stuff.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Not really... I'm not sad. I just... sit there.
Do you feel down or low most of the day, even when you're not doing anything?
I mean... no. I told you, I'm not sad. I just... I don't feel much of anything.
Do you feel empty or numb inside, even when you're not doing anything?

I guess... maybe numb. I just... I can't really make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room... usually in the same clothes. I don't knit or write in my journal... I don't go for walks like I used to. My mom asks what's wrong and... I just don't have the energy to tell her anything.

...No. I don't think so. It's not low, it's just... nothing. Like I said. I just don't have a mood.
